title: Cinderscape | A Lava Rising Plugin
description: A Lavarising Plugin with Multiple Gamemodes and Unique items.
body:
🔥 Cinderscape — Lava Rising Minigame
Cinderscape is a fully automated, action-packed Lava Rising minigame plugin built for Paper and Purpur 1.21.1+. It handles arena world generation, lobby voting, custom kit delivery, and team mechanics natively out of the box.

🎮 Core Features:
Interactive Lobby Voting: Vote on game modes (Naked, Diamond, Full Kit), team formats (Solo, Duos), and Chaos modifiers.
Duos Support: Includes teammate radar compasses, a live partner distance tracker HUD, and a right-click channeling reboot system to revive dead allies.
Kill Siphon: Earn 5.0 Hearts (+10 HP) instantly upon eliminating any player.
Admin Lava Controls: Pause and resume the rising lava dynamically with /cinderscape pause and /cinderscape continue.
Chaos Mode Modifiers: Drops every player random unique items that have custom effects periodically.
Sudden Death: Shrinks the border and triggers acid rain when build height is reached to force a dramatic end to matches.
